stage_at_freeze: Method and limits frozen before case delivery or output generation; source case will be reconciled and hash-frozen before dispatch.
hypothesis: A bounded responsive reader dialogue can improve explanatory emphasis while preserving the factual contract. Native detector change remains unknown.
design: One new longer synthetic development case, baseline current skill versus same skill plus two-turn reader dialogue before drafting. Manual Pangram pilot; not controller CLI execution.
length: Approximately 300–350 words for a requested explanatory article; no padding or scope cuts for detector access. Both arms use the same source and request. Longer genre is not itself an experimentally isolated intervention.
writers: Fresh separate baseline/candidate contexts; same inherited model and effort, exact runtime identifier unexposed. Candidate incurs extra interaction/context as part of workflow.
reader: Fresh agent sees question, source and inventory, never original text, other outputs or detector results. Exactly one question then at most one response-dependent follow-up. RESOLVED is allowed; NO_SUPPORTED_CHALLENGE stops case unexercised.
quality: Separate masked reviewer sees original, evidence, exact two outputs; methods/dialogue/scores hidden. Both must pass correctness, completeness, relevance, professional tone. Candidate must be at least as readable as baseline.
repairs: At most one pre-score repair per arm for independently identified factual/clarity defects, preserving first-pass outputs. No post-score edits. No cost-driven text repair.
mechanism: Retain full exchange and claim references. A separate process audit checks no introduced facts and whether final text addresses the identified distinction. If final is identical to original or baseline except terminal newline, record inactive/no-op and do not scan.

measurement.model: record live displayed, require identical within pair
measurement.reservation: Save full-text UI quotes for both arms before the first submission and verify that the complete pair is available. Retain exact source, submitted, textarea and rendered text; native Overview/Details/model/warnings and screenshots privately. No retries after uncertain submission.
measurement.endpoint: Native document label and separately displayed fully-AI text fraction. Missing fractions remain null; no cross-vendor unit conversions.
measurement.success: Quality passes, and either at least5 percentage points lower comparable fully-AI fraction or better native label (AI Generated > AI Assisted > Human Written), with neither worse native label nor increased comparable fully-AI fraction. Unknown/incomparable outputs or discordant metrics are indeterminate, not success.
measurement.stopping: One pair only regardless of scores. No holdout release or post-score variants in this round; favorable result remains development-only.

gptzero: No GPTZero scan in this round: the available allowance could not cover a complete pair.
publication: No GitHub answer activity. Raw account evidence remains private. No detector-method promotion without further confirmation.
pending_sample: No authentic user writing sample supplied; voice imitation excluded.
export_note: Sanitized copy of the protocol frozen before generation. Renamed the public study and removed private account balances and publication instructions; method, admission, success and stopping conditions are unchanged.
